description: This file defines a data class RailViews which encapsulates references to various UI components of a 'rail' in an Android TV application. It provides a helper method to instantiate RailViews from a root View by locating child views via their resource IDs.

classes.name: RailViews
classes.description: A container data class that holds references to key UI components of a 'rail' in the application, facilitating safe access.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Factory method to create a RailViews instance by locating child views within the provided root view.
